commands.command:
sudo -n tee /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_HAPROXY'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    log /dev/log local1 notice
    user haproxy
    group haproxy
    daemon

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    option dontlognull
    option redispatch
    timeout connect 3s
    timeout client 30s
    timeout server 30s

frontend http_in
    bind *:80
    default_backend nginx_nodes

backend nginx_nodes
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk GET /
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 2s fall 2 rise 2
    server node1 10.100.204.10:5660 check
    server node2 10.100.204.11:5660 check
    server node3 10.100.204.12:5660 check
ANTRIEB_HAPROXY
sudo -n haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
sudo -n systemctl enable haproxy
sudo -n systemctl restart haproxy
